Liana Swing.name: Liana Swing
Liana Swing.description: The user throws a vine to a ledge, a lamppost or a branch, anchors it and swings or climbs along it, crossing a street-wide gap or reaching a rooftop in one move with a passenger held in a loop of vine. The line stays anchored afterward, so others can climb it or be lowered down it. Strain: moderate.
